t: You're at the site of Stratford Langthorne Abbey, a Cistercian monastery founded in 1135, when this was still Essex. It was one of the largest Cistercian abbeys in England, with 1,500 acres of local land and control of over twenty manors across Essex. It was also called West Ham Abbey, and its head was the Abbot of West Ham. The publisher James Reynolds, who lived from 1817 to 1876, was born here.
